== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]]: the PC card image of [[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]] (7 August 2025, [[:File:V25-D-thefirstorderreigns-2025-08-07.png|V25-D-thefirstorderreigns-2025-08-07.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 5). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
